note: TEST-REVIEW.md Delivery 4 (T5, 2026-10-14; the 4P prototype first): the curated spec lists the profiles run -- the release's built targets, the extra browsers' files and tags, the quick tier -- in one place the runner reads (scripts/run-e2e-profile.mjs) and tests/unit/profile-membership.spec.js checks. The profiles themselves (id, target, browser, build, which list) are scripts/test-profiles.mjs's. The source profile is the whole of tests/e2e and lists nothing here: an ordinary spec needs no registration. A spec that branches on a built target (currentTarget === 'web', and the like) must be a member of that target's list, or the branch never runs anywhere; the check reads the specs' syntax trees for exactly that.
